about: Coverage gate rules for scripts/coverage_gate.py (testing-standards TS-UT-02). Globs are fnmatch patterns relative to the repo root; * also crosses /. Add a group with minimum 100 for each pure-logic folder (formatters, scorecard model, score entry, handicap) as it is created. A group that matches no files fails unless it sets allowEmpty; "v2 app code" sets it only until the first v2 source file lands (remove it then).
